points.title: Accepted write
points.condition: i_wr_en=1, o_full=0, i_rst_n_sw=1 and o_sw_rst_busy=0 at a write clock edge.

points.title: Write requested while full (not blocked)
points.condition: i_wr_en=1 and o_full=1 with no software reset block.

points.title: o_overflow pulse seen
points.condition: o_overflow=1 at a write clock edge.

points.title: Consecutive overflow pulses (back-to-back rejects)
points.condition: o_overflow=1 at two consecutive write edges.

points.title: o_full rises outside software reset
points.condition: o_full goes 0 to 1 with no block in the previous or current cycle.

points.title: o_full falls outside software reset (late fall after read)
points.condition: o_full goes 1 to 0 with no block in the previous or current cycle.

points.title: o_full falls at write release of software reset
points.condition: o_sw_rst_busy falls with i_rst_n_sw=1 and o_full=0.

points.title: Full back-pressure held with write requests for 3+ cycles
points.condition: Third or later consecutive cycle of an unblocked write request while full.

points.title: One-cycle i_rst_n_sw low pulse
points.condition: i_rst_n_sw back to 1 after exactly one low cycle.

points.title: i_rst_n_sw held low 3+ cycles
points.condition: i_rst_n_sw low for the third or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: Write attempted while i_rst_n_sw is low
Write attempted while busy with i_rst_n_sw at 1
i_rst_n_sw driven low again while busy
points.condition: i_rst_n_sw falls while o_sw_rst_busy was and is 1.

points.title: One-cycle busy gap between back-to-back sequences
First accepted write after hardware reset
points.condition: First accepted write since write reset.

points.title: Write pointer wrap (2*DEPTH accepted writes)
points.condition: Accepted write that completes 2*DEPTH writes since reset or block.

points.title: Write burst of DEPTH or more consecutive accepted writes
points.condition: Accepted write that is at least the DEPTH-th consecutive.

points.title: Consecutive underflow pulses
points.condition: o_underflow=1 at two consecutive read edges.

points.title: Empty back-pressure with read requests for 3+ cycles
points.condition: Third or later consecutive cycle of read request while empty.

points.title: Read burst of DEPTH or more consecutive accepted reads
points.condition: Accepted read that is at least the DEPTH-th consecutive.

points.title: Mid i_empty_thr reached while not empty
First accepted read after hardware reset
points.condition: First accepted read since read reset.

points.title: Read request on empty right after a draining read
points.condition: i_rd_en=1, o_empty=1 and the previous cycle was an accepted read.
